title: Bands at the Nest Club
summary: Sam Wooding's orchestra and Danny Wilson's band played at the Nest, and Wooding then left for the Club Alabama and Europe.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Who was there at the Nest? Who was working with you?

Sam Wooding's orchestra was there. And, um, then, uh, let me see, what other people, orchestra was there? Uh, Danny Wilson, that was Edith Wilson's husband, he had a band there. And, oh, there was two, three different bands there, you know, from a minute ago. Because, uh, Sam Wooding's and left them when they opened up the band, that Club Alabama downtown in New York, then they left the Nest to go down to the Club Alabama. That's where the Frenchman, it was a Frenchman, I think, only, he took them to Paris, he took them to Europe.
